name: cornice
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE INDIVIDUAL MODULAR architectural stone piece for a premium stylized tropical ruined temple game. Hand-sculpted low-poly massing, broad softened/chipped bevels, calm tactile planes. Muted warm limestone and sage-grey, dark desaturated teal only in carved recesses, pale warm rubbed edges, very sparse moss in creases. Restrained painterly material, no shiny gold, no photoreal grit, no excessive scratches. Neutral soft studio light. Entire isolated piece on plain light grey with generous margin, no floor, no building, no other pieces, no letters or watermark. Three-quarter orthographic product view so the profile and top surface are clear. One STRAIGHT CORNICE BLOCK, 3m long in the left-right direction, 0.75m high, 1.15m deep. Cross section consists of a slim lower squared ledge, a broad outward flaring sloped bevel, and a flat projecting upper cap. The front edge projects like the eave of a stone temple roof. Both end faces are square and perfectly flat so multiple blocks join end to end. A single plain dark-sage horizontal recessed groove below the cap. No carvings or logos. Only one corner is lightly chipped.
